question: Can even immense material wealth equal the value of the Kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is imagined
This is posed as a measure of comparison
inference: Even the accumulation of an ocean filled with jewels is set up as incomparable to this teaching.
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is a fused and irregular form, possibly for ratnasaṃpūrṇaṃ kartum
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to fill the ocean with jewels.
